integrity.computational_evidence: exact rational finite-state tests, not a universal proof
integrity.theorem_proof: complete elementary edge-cut proof, not a numerical inference

scientific_limitations: Independent species extinctions; monotone full-range extinction trajectories; unrooted phylogenetic diversity; guaranteed survival of protected species.
No claim for correlated extinctions, restricted severity ranges, weighted protection cost, or empirical deployment.
A close previous single-taxon HED edge-product theorem could lead to the pairwise result after an additional difference; complete specialized subset-optimization literature was not all accessible.
title: A universal one-crossing law for pairwise protection in unrooted phylogenetic diversity
